verses.english: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

verses.pali: “Yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, rāgo appahīno, doso appahīno, moho appahīno—
verses.english: “Whoever has not given up greed, hate, and delusion

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, ‘baddho mārassa paṭimukkassa mārapāso yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato’.
verses.english: is said to be trapped. They’re caught in Māra’s snare, and the Wicked One can do with them what he wants.

verses.pali: Yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, rāgo pahīno, doso pahīno, moho pahīno—
verses.english: Whoever has given up greed, hate, and delusion

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, ‘abaddho mārassa omukkassa mārapāso na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato’”ti.
verses.english: is said to be free. They’re released from Māra’s snare, and the Wicked One cannot do with them what he wants.”
“Those in whom greed, hate, and ignorance
belong with those who are evolved;
they’ve given up everything, they say.”

verses.pali: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
verses.english: This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
